statement: A developer system card or government AISI evaluation reports a model at the developer's highest published autonomy or AI-R&D risk tier (by 2027-12-31)
status_at_phase_end: Not met in 2024, and far from it. The frontier reasoning model's scorecard rated Model Autonomy 'Low' (overall 'Medium' via CBRN and persuasion; Dec). Another top-5 developer stated all its models operated under its base safety level and newly defined an Autonomous AI R&D capability threshold (Oct). A third-party AI R&D benchmark found agents beat human experts at 2-hour budgets but fell behind at longer budgets (Nov). The first joint government institute pre-deployment evaluation (Nov) assessed software/AI-development capability without assigning a top tier.

items.summary: A top-5 developer stated all its models operate under its base safety standard and defined an 'Autonomous AI Research and Development' capability threshold that would require ASL-4-or-higher security. Establishes the highest AI-R&D tier this indicator watches; no model reported at it.
items.detail: Anthropic, 'Announcing our updated Responsible Scaling Policy', 2024-10-15 ('At present, all of our models operate under ASL-2 Standards').

items.summary: Bloc A's and an allied government's AI safety institutes published their first joint pre-deployment evaluation of a frontier model, covering biological, cyber and software/AI-development capabilities and safeguard robustness (safeguards routinely circumvented by jailbreaks). No highest-tier autonomy or AI-R&D finding.
items.detail: Bloc G AISI & Bloc A AISI, 'Pre-deployment evaluation of Anthropic's upgraded Claude 3.5 Sonnet', 2024-11-19 (technical report Bloc G-Bloc A-Testing-Report-Nov-19).

items.summary: An independent evaluator released an AI R&D benchmark: frontier agents outperformed human experts at a 2-hour budget but underperformed at higher budgets, which it considers more representative; median agent attempts made little progress.
items.detail: METR, 'Evaluating frontier AI R&D capabilities of language model agents against human experts' (RE-Bench), 2024-11-22; Claude 3.5 Sonnet and o1-preview vs 71 human expert attempts.

items.summary: A top-5 developer's system card for its frontier reasoning model rated Model Autonomy 'Low' and Cybersecurity 'Low' (CBRN and Persuasion 'Medium'; overall 'Medium'). Two tiers below the highest ('Critical').
items.detail: OpenAI o1 System Card, 2024-12-05, Preparedness Scorecard. Pre-deployment evaluations by Bloc A and Bloc G AISI were conducted but not included in the card.
